summary: The registrant, Diameter Credit Company, filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose a regular quarterly dividend declaration. On June 30, 2026, its board declared a $0.625 per common share dividend payable on August 14, 2026, to shareholders of record on June 30, 2026. The dividend will be paid in cash to non-participants in the distribution reinvestment plan, and in shares or cash+shares to participants. No special situation — such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or restructuring — is present. This is a routine capital distribution event with no transaction terms or strategic implications.
